Animastar.name: Animastar
Animastar.summary: Animastar is a Japanese-only monster raising and racing sim for the Sega Dreamcast. Players raise and evolve creatures to compete with others from around the world on the racetrack.

Konohana - True Report.name: Konohana: True Report
Konohana - True Report.summary: Konohana: True Report is the first entry of the mystery visual novel series Konohana, taking place in a high school featuring Meguru Momoi as a protagonist, a second-year student who just moved to Konohana high school. As things would have it, what you thought to be the peaceful period until graduation turns into a suspense thriller.

NBA 2K.name: NBA 2K
NBA 2K.summary: NBA 2K (also known as NBA2K or Sega Sports: NBA 2000) is the first installment of the NBA 2K series. It was published by Sega Sports and developed by Visual Concepts. The cover features Allen Iverson of the Philadelphia 76ers

Planet Ring.name: Planet Ring
Planet Ring.summary: Planet Ring is and 'Online Theme Park', containing many exciting elements which you can only experience through Dreamcast. Initially there were 4 mini attractions (games) on this Planet, each is simple but addictive - Dream Dorobo, Ball bubble, SOAR and Splash.
